svg.aria-label: Folder Export, Pipesmith Registry 0.2.1. An export counts from the index first, then streams the files of the blob stores and writes nothing. 1: Browser to Server: GET ?path=<folder>&dry=1. 2: Server to index.sqlite: list the folder, count files and bytes. 3: Server: at most 20,000 files and 2 GiB; entry names checked. 4: Server to Browser: 200 form, name, files, bytes; 413 over a limit. 5: Browser to Server: dry=1 again, then the download. 6: Server: two exports at a time, one per account, else 429. 7: Server to Blob stores: each file as a download reads it. 8: Server to Browser: 200 zip or tar, streamed. 9: Server: ends after 60 s unread or 2 hours; writes one log line.
svg.title: Pipesmith Registry folder export
